device_entry.name: 文件夹图像采集源
tags: 实验数据可视化与分析
离线图像回放与虚拟相机输入
device_entry.description: 一种基于文件夹的图像输入源，可将磁盘中的图像文件按名称或创建时间顺序作为连续视频流读取，并可监视文件夹中的新增或删除图像。适用于实验室中回放已采集的显微图像或相机图像、测试图像处理流程，以及在无实体相机时模拟视频输入。
device_entry.description_en: A folder-based image input source that reads image files from disk as a continuous video stream, ordered by filename or creation time, and can monitor the folder for added or removed images. It is useful in laboratories for replaying previously acquired microscope or camera images, testing image-processing workflows, and simulating a video input when no physical camera is connected.
